During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Toluz Cheq]] possessed an '''R3-series astromech droid'''. The droid was destroyed along with its owner during a [[Battle of the Rial Kroon system|battle]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] in the [[Rial Kroon system/Legends|Rial Kroon system]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
